result.instructions: Tools for Faktuo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Make an invoice PDF for Acme s.r.o.: 8 hours of consulting at 1500 CZK per hour, VAT 21 %."; "Create a credit note that cancels invoice FA-26-08-231 after a withdrawal within 14 days."; "Generate an English quote in the modern template for a website redesign, with accent #2563eb.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Faktuo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run faktuo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run faktuo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run faktuo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. faktuo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: faktuo_create_invoice_pdf
tools.title: Create an invoice PDF
tools.description: Generate an invoice, proforma, tax document for an advance, or quote as a PDF from the fields you send. Send the supplier and items; add a customer and doc_number as needed. Faktuo keeps no record: nothing appears in the Faktuo account and no number is assigned. Returns { filename, byteLength, pdfBase64, qr_status }. Faktuo API: POST /api/v1/pdf (Pro plan).

doc_type.description: invoice = tax invoice; proforma = advance-payment request; proforma_tax = tax document for a received advance; quote = price offer (no payment QR).

doc_number.description: Document number, e.g. FA-26-04-001. Required for invoice and proforma_tax.

payment_method.description: prevodem = bank transfer (default), hotove = cash, kartou = card.

variable_symbol.description: Variable symbol for the payment (default: the digits of doc_number). Not printed on credit notes.

proforma_pct.description: Advance in percent. Only for proforma and proforma_tax.

qr.description: Print a SPAYD QR payment code. Needs supplier.bank. CZK only.

template.description: Layout. Default: the template set in Faktuo's settings.

language.description: Language of labels and headings (default cs). Your data keeps its own language.

currency.description: Default CZK. A QR payment code is printed for CZK only.

vat_enabled.description: true when the supplier charges VAT.

vat_rate.description: Default VAT rate in % when an item has none (default 21).

notes.description: Free text in the document footer.

bank.description: Bank account: 123-4567/0100, 19-123456789/0710 or an IBAN. Needed for a QR payment code.

is_vat_payer.description: true when the supplier is registered for VAT.

entity_type.description: firma = company, osvc = sole trader. Changes the footer text.

court.description: Register entry (company) or registering authority (sole trader).

total.description: Line total without VAT. If omitted, quantity × price.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate in % for this item only.

tools.name: faktuo_create_credit_note_pdf
tools.title: Create a credit note PDF
tools.description: Generate a credit note (opravný doklad / storno) as a PDF that cancels one invoice. Send the original invoice's number in corrects and positive amounts; the PDF labels the total as 'to be refunded'. Faktuo keeps no record and links it to no invoice in the account. Returns { filename, byteLength, pdfBase64, qr_status }. Faktuo API: POST /api/v1/pdf (Pro plan).

doc_number.description: Number of this credit note. Required; the server does not number it.
Number of the original invoice, exactly as printed on it.

issue_date.description: Issue date of the original invoice.

reason.description: Reason for the correction, e.g. 'Withdrawal from the contract within 14 days'.

corrects.description: The original invoice that this credit note corrects.

template.description: Layout. Default: the template set in Faktuo's settings.

language.description: Language of labels and headings (default cs). Your data keeps its own language.

currency.description: Default CZK. A QR payment code is printed for CZK only.

vat_enabled.description: true when the supplier charges VAT.

vat_rate.description: Default VAT rate in % when an item has none (default 21).

notes.description: Free text in the document footer.

bank.description: Bank account: 123-4567/0100, 19-123456789/0710 or an IBAN. Needed for a QR payment code.

is_vat_payer.description: true when the supplier is registered for VAT.

entity_type.description: firma = company, osvc = sole trader. Changes the footer text.

court.description: Register entry (company) or registering authority (sole trader).

price.description: Unit price without VAT, positive. Negative amounts are refused.

total.description: Line total without VAT, positive. Negative amounts are refused.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate in % for this item only.

items.description: Line items, 1 to 200, with positive amounts.
